title: Fire in Saga home leaves four dead, including two children
summary: A fire destroyed a two-story house in Imari, Saga Prefecture, causing the deaths of four people, including two minors.

title: Approval for Prime Minister Takaichi's cabinet plummets, and she says she doesn't understand the reasons
summary: Polls show a significant drop in government support to 57%, and Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi admits she does not know the reasons for the decline.

title: Vehicle attack at Berlin LGBT parade; police shoot suspect linked to Islamic State
summary: A driver rammed into the crowd at a pride march in Berlin, causing injuries; the attacker, a supporter of the Islamic State, was shot dead by police while attempting to flee.

title: US Central Command recommends stopping attacks on Iran due to limited effectiveness
summary: The commander of US Central Command advised ceasing offensive operations against Iran, which contributed to the suspension of bombings.

title: Kazakhstan's president asks Putin to freeze the invasion of Ukraine; Russia rejects it
summary: The Kazakh leader directly urged Vladimir Putin to stop the aggression, but Moscow called the proposal impossible and the Russian president ignored it.

title: Munetaka Murakami hits two home runs to reach 22 in the NPB season
summary: The Yakult Swallows slugger hit two home runs in a game in front of his parents, reaching 22 homers this season.

title: Fukuoka assembly members testify about alleged money exchange
summary: In a press conference, legislators revealed details of an alleged illegal transfer scheme, and audio analysis pointed to the former vice president as the requester.

title: Corporate services price index rises 3.2% year-on-year in June
summary: Japan's corporate services price index rose 3.2% from the previous year, although the growth rate is slowing down.

title: Asuka-Fujiwara archaeological sites inscribed as World Heritage
summary: A day after the declaration, the town of Asuka celebrated with banners, while a virtual experience is promoted to learn about the buried remains.

title: Former official wins Genkai mayoral election and will have to decide on nuclear waste study
summary: Hidaka, a former section chief, was elected mayor; he will have to determine whether to proceed with the second phase of research for nuclear waste storage.

title: Ten years after the massacre at the Yamayuri center, the community remembers the victims
summary: The 10th anniversary of the attack on the disabled center in Sagamihara, which killed 19 people, is commemorated; events are held to keep the memory alive.

title: Ishin party expels Hyogo assembly member for renting vehicles without permission
summary: Nippon Ishin no Kai expelled a Hyogo assembly member who operated a car rental service without authorization from the transport ministry.

title: Prime Minister Takaichi to hold press conference to explain consumption tax reduction
summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is set to give a press conference to detail the plans for reducing consumption tax on food, as expectations grow.
